subject: ast: Allow SELECT statements to set user-defined variables in read-only mode. (#59354)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for parser/planner only. Change makes `ast.IsReadOnly` treat SELECT user-variable assignment (`@var := expr`) as read-only (still rejecting locking SELECTs), and the planner read-only gate (`allowInReadOnlyMode`) now uses the updated read-only check so these statements are allowed under `tidb_super_read_only`/restricted read-only. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics, read-only enforcement, or related session/transaction interactions impacted by these changes.
